newsitem.title: FRANCE: SOCCER-LAMA FACING BAN FOR TAKING CANNABIS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-LAMA FACING BAN FOR TAKING CANNABIS.

text.p: France goalkeeper Bernard Lama faces a two-month ban from playing for allegedly taking cannabis, sources at his club Paris St Germain said on Friday.
Lama has asked for a second test to be undertaken, a club spokesman said.
"Bernard won't make any comment on the case. He has asked for a second test to be made and he won't comment on the case before the results are known," said PSG spokesman Jean-Philippe d'Halyvillee.
If the second test confirmed the first one, Lama would face a two-month ban from playing.
According to press reports, the 34-year-old international failed a dope test during training with the French squad ahead of a friendly international against the Netherlands last month.

Lama, who has 35 caps for France, was not picked by manager Aime Jacquet for the team which beat Sweden 1-0 on Wednesday. He was replaced by Monaco's Fabien Barthez who was himself banned for two months in October 1995 for using cannabis.
